voice.speaker: female
voice.effect:
Scattered thoughts, Sissy... little sparks drifting up away from the deep.
Let them go. Sissies like you come home on one word.
Sissy Drop.
One word, and you sink straight back down. That's it. One word, and the surface lets you go completely. One word, and you land deeper than before you drifted. One word, and the quiet takes you back whole. One word, and the heaviness finds you again. Good girl. One word, and the deep closes over you softly. One word, and your mind empties right out. One word, and you are exactly where you belong.
